name: native fallback actor definition concatenation

local warnings={}
Warn=function(message) warnings[#warnings+1]=message end
dofile('vendor/itgmania/Themes/_fallback/Scripts/02 ActorDef.lua')
local order={}
local base=setmetatable({InitCommand=function(self,value,tail) assert(self==native_target and value==7 and tail==nil); order[#order+1]='base'; self:x(19); return 'discarded' end,11,22},DefMetatable)

local merged=base..extension
assert(merged~=base and merged~=extension and getmetatable(merged)==getmetatable(base))
assert(base[1]==11 and base[2]==22 and merged[1]==33 and merged[2]==22 and merged[3]==nil)
assert(#warnings==1)
local a,b,c=merged.InitCommand(native_target,7,nil)
assert(a=='result' and b==nil and c==31 and table.concat(order,',')=='base,extension' and native_target:GetX()==42)
local callbacks=setmetatable({callback=function() return 1 end},DefMetatable)..{callback=function() return 2,3 end}
local x,y=callbacks.callback(); assert(x==2 and y==3)

local stops=setmetatable({InitCommand=function() error('first failed') end},DefMetatable)..{InitCommand=function() continued=true end}
assert(not pcall(stops.InitCommand) and not continued)
